summary: Large search sessions now default to three expanded requested-card groups, with remaining groups collapsed for scanability. Result groups no longer shrink inside the outer flex scroller.
evidence: Successful searches collapse groups after the first three
Session-level failed searches apply the same collapse rule
.sc-group has flex: 0 0 auto to prevent clipped internal scroll containers
knownLimitations: The expanded group count is fixed in code for V1 and is not yet user-configurable.
